scope: Bind local Docker external-storage smoke evidence to launch-contract-proved local readiness without weakening production gates.

changes.summary: Allows local-reference smoke planning to accept live local readiness evidence that is blocked only because it is not production, while still requiring matching storage fingerprint and proved production launch contract.
Adds RED/GREEN coverage for local-reference smoke readiness binding with a persistent-volume launch contract proof.

redGreen.red: npm run test -- tests/external-storage-smoke.test.ts -t "allows local reference smoke planning" failed with external-storage-service-readiness-evidence-not-live-ready before implementation.
redGreen.green: npm run test -- tests/external-storage-smoke.test.ts -t "allows local reference smoke planning" passed after implementation.
